title: Deterministic scenario compiler for on-prem VPC trace replays + regression detector
creator: Aisha Banerjee
description:
Background: Customers running Redwood Private frequently observe performance quirks that only appear in their VPC/on-prem topology (KV cache warmup, split across racks, bursty traffic from upstream proxies). We need a deterministic harness that can: 1) capture sanitized token-level traces from customer environments; 2) compile those traces into reproducible workload scenarios that preserve request timing, sequence-length distribution, and cache-warmup behavior; and 3) run those scenarios in a local on-prem emulator to measure tokens/sec, p95 latency, and spot regressions vs baseline.

Goals:
- Produce a "scenario compiler" that transforms a sanitized trace (token timestamps, model variant, input prefixes, network delays) into a runnable workload spec.
- Ensure runs are deterministic given a seed: same scenario + seed -> same token emission schedule and KV-cache initial state.
- Add a regression detector component that compares new runs to baseline using multiple signals (p95 latency, p50, tokens/sec, error-rate, tail completion status) and raises alerts when statistically significant regressions are detected.
- Keep PII out of artifacts: apply sanitizers to any captured text and store only fingerprints and token-level metadata.

Design / Architecture:
- Trace Capture: lightweight agent (trace-collector) runs in customer VPC (sidecar or agent) and emits sanitized protobuf with per-token timestamps, model id, seed hints, and topology tags.
- Sanitizer: pipeline that removes PII, replaces texts with stable fingerprints, and preserves tokenization boundary metadata.
- Scenario Compiler: converts trace into a workload spec (sequence groups, inter-request delays, per-group KV-cache warmup steps). The compiler outputs YAML scenario files and a deterministic RNG seed.
- Topology Emulator: docker-compose / k8s profiles that emulate customer latency knobs (inter-node latency, bandwidth cap, CPU/GPU contention) for on-prem reproduction.
- Runner & Recorder: harness that executes scenarios against a target runtime (private or local) and records token/sec, per-request latencies, p50/p95/p99, and completion anomalies.
- Regression Detector: stats engine using EWMA + nonparametric Mann-Whitney U tests for latency distributions, plus a Bayesian changepoint detector for sudden shifts. A thresholding/alerting policy maps tests to severity and auto-opens regression tickets if above threshold.

Metrics & Acceptance Criteria:
- Determinism: repeated runs of the same scenario+seed produce p95 within 3% and tokens/sec within 5% (on same emulator profile).
- Fidelity: when replaying customer trace in their environment mirror, our harness reproduces p95 within 10% and tokens/sec within 10% of customer telemetry.
- Regression detection: false positive rate < 5% on historical stable baselines and true positive detection of known regressions from past incidents (validate on ENG-24622, ENG-30012 sample failures).
- Privacy: captured traces are sanitized and validated by security review before storage.

Rollout plan:
1) Prototype compiler and sanitizer (this ticket).
2) Validate determinism using synthetic traces and internal on-prem lab.
3) Run controlled replays with 2 pilot customers (opt-in) in staging.
4) Integrate regression detector with Console alerts and create auto-ticket flow.

Dependencies: ENG-24622 (vpc-onprem-benchmark-orchestrator), ENG-30012 (customer-topology-replay-compiler), ENG-36245 (telemetry-led-replay-harness).

Artifacts: Confluence design doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/INF/pages/SCENARIO_COMPILER; Prototype PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1427; Benchmark dashboard (staging): https://grafana.redwood.dev/d/bench/replay-harness-staging

Risks & Mitigations:
- Risk: Overfitting compiler to a small set of customers. Mitigation: build fuzzing harness to generate variations of timing and sequence length.
- Risk: PII leakage. Mitigation: require sanitizer + security sign-off before ingestion; store only fingerprints.
- Risk: False positives in regression detector. Mitigation: multi-signal checks and manual review step for P1 alerts in first 30 days.
